effects.effect:
You have an epic resource called [primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power). Each time you finish a [respite](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/respite), you gain [primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power) equal to the [XP](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.resource/experience) you gain. You can spend [primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power) on your abilities as if it were ferocity.

Additionally, you can spend any amount of [primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power) as a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver), ending one effect on you for each [primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power) spent.

You can also spend 3 [primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power) to create a portal to Quintessence without needing a source of elemental power.

[Primordial power](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.fury.level-10/primordial-power) remains until you spend it.
